develop_target_rationale: Phase 3 perfect-recovery implementation is develop-only against a locally-running Worker (wrangler dev on http://127.0.0.1:8787); cms.kodigital.app is production-pending. No Cloudflare production deploy is performed by /a2z-develop. Ralph and the Phase B reviewer assert behavior at the local worker; the live cms.kodigital.app domain is reachable only after /a2z-ship runs `wrangler deploy --env production` (user-owned, deploy-safety.md).
production_status_reasoning: wrangler.toml [env.production].ADMIN_HOST = 'cms.kodigital.app' is configured for production (deploy-time wiring).
DNS pointing cms.kodigital.app → Cloudflare Worker route is provisioned at the registrar / Cloudflare dashboard layer, NOT by this mission.
Domain routability check (HTTP GET https://cms.kodigital.app/health) is deferred to /a2z-ship D_MANUALQA + post-deploy verification (deploy-safety.md D4).
The mission's domain-create flow exercises the *database side* of site→domain wiring (sites + domains tables, site_id resolution by Host header), NOT external DNS / cert issuance.

domains.develop_substitute_reasoning: Chromium browser context refuses to set the Host request header via extraHTTPHeaders (returns net::ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT). Develop substitutes ADMIN_HOST=127.0.0.1 so the off-admin-host gate in api/src/index.ts accepts /admin* requests against the baseURL Playwright actually sends. The production form is unchanged via wrangler.toml [env.production].ADMIN_HOST = 'cms.kodigital.app'.
evidence_routes: T13.AC2 (off-admin-host /admin returns 404 + no-store + noindex/nofollow + no leak — verified at develop_target)
T15.AC1 (admin-ux-parity across 9 routes — verified at develop_target)

domains.develop_substitute: demo-acme.example (literal Host header asserted by curl + Playwright request fixture in T13)
domains.develop_substitute_reasoning: demo-acme.example is the per-mission canonical off-admin-host literal asserted by T13.AC2. It is a synthetic example domain (RFC 6761 .example TLD reserved for documentation) — no DNS resolution required. The test asserts the Host gate's NEGATIVE path (off-admin-host /admin returns 404).

Tenant sites are resolved by Host header → sites.domain WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. The kodigital.app apex is the canonical tenant homepage; the Worker resolves Host → site_id and routes per the public-tenant render path (Phase 3 in-scope but verified at the *database* level by T6 / T8 / T10 site-scoped filters, not by live DNS).
